title: GrabThat | AI for Businesses That Know Their Business | GrabThat.ai
excerpt: GrabThat is a configurable Windows-native local AI tool for businesses that know their business. Accelerate your existing processes and achieve strategic goals without changing how you work.
content_html:
Can you grab that? Simple AI that uses natural language to connect you to your documents.

GrabThat is the first Windows desktop launcher that uses natural language processing to connect you to your work the way you naturally think.

AI shouldn't force a new way of working or replace your process. Instead, GrabThat acts as a configurable desktop hub that seamlessly connects local models, team directories, and automated workflows directly to your existing setup—helping you achieve your strategic goals effortlessly.

Try it today.

Free download • Runs 100% offline • Windows 10 & 11

GrabThat

You don't have to know everything. You just have to know where to find it.

Launch Terminal

KeyCtrl

+

Hotkey

Space

This is the access hot-key that activates the launch terminal.

Press Ctrl + Space anywhere on your desktop to summon GrabThat instantly.

AI powered solution that configures to you.Not the other way around.

Most AI tools try to force a blanket transformation or change how your team operates. GrabThat takes a fundamentals-first approach: a configurable, local-first Windows hub that works alongside your existing operations, connecting directly to your local files and databases.

Features

Input each of these headings into the launcher to access the other tools.

What Teams Are Saying

Honest feedback from professionals using GrabThat every day.

Knowledge Sharing

GrabThat features both a personal database and a shared team database. Shared connections empower leadership to direct teams to verified sources of truth. Connect standard operating procedures to natural language—such as asking, “I need help with my timesheet”—and get team members straight to the answers they need.

What can you connect to?

Applications, files, folders, websites, documentation, workflow scripts, team channels, and your imagination.

One to try, another to grab hold of.
